svg.aria-label: Mandelbrot iteration counts and idle lanes per warp
svg.title: Mandelbrot iteration counts and idle lanes per warp
svg.text: Why the Mandelbrot set is the poster child for divergence
Left: iterations each pixel needed. Right: iterations its warp (8 pixels in a row) had to issue. The difference is idle lane time.
green = lane busy until its warp finished; magenta = lane idle
Loop iterations needed vs issued: 77%. Whole-kernel SIMD efficiency on the RTL: 73%.
Warp boundaries are the thick vertical lines. Warps on the edge of the set are the expensive ones.
